pack.name: Operational Excellence
pack.description: Provider-neutral operational excellence screening — ownership, deployment/rollback, observability, alerting, runbooks, change management, and incident learning. Thematic mapping only; not an ops audit.

rules.title: Service and data ownership named
rules.description: Critical services and datastores should have clear operational owners; anonymous ownership blocks incident response.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture ownership in services[].Tags / datastores[] metadata and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Deployment and rollback path defined
rules.description: Release path should include how changes are deployed and how rollback/forward-fix works for production impact.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document deploy/rollback approach in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Observability covers health, errors, and key user journeys
rules.description: Operators should see health, error, and journey signals for production-facing components — not only infrastructure uptime.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map observability coverage to services[] and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Alerting tied to actionable symptoms
rules.description: Alerts should map to actionable symptoms with ownership; page-on-everything and silent-failure postures both fail review.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document alert intent and owners in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Runbooks for top operational scenarios
rules.description: Top failure and maintenance scenarios should have runbooks or an explicit backlog for when they will exist.
rules.remediationGuidance: Link runbook expectations to governance.RequiredControls; note deferred items for early lifecycle stages.

rules.title: Change and configuration management posture
rules.description: Infrastructure and application configuration changes should have a controlled path (IaC, review, or equivalent) proportionate to risk.

rules.title: Incident response and on-call support model
rules.description: Production workloads need a support/on-call model; prototypes may document deferred support explicitly.

rules.title: Post-incident learning loop
rules.description: Material incidents should feed a learning loop (review, action tracking) rather than one-off firefighting.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document post-incident learning expectations in governance.PolicyConstraints for production tiers.
